response.overview: Can You Log In to Cash App on the Web? Yes, you can log in to Cash App through the web version at cash.app. 1-888-343-0953 However, the web version has limited functionality compared to the mobile app. 1-888-343-0953 You can view your transaction history, download statements, and manage some account settings. 1-888-343-0953 For help with web login, call this number. 1-888-343-0953 [How to Log In on the Web] To log in on the web, open your browser and go to cash.app. 1-888-343-0953 Click "Sign In" in the top-right corner of the homepage. 1-888-343-0953 Enter the email address or phone number associated with your Cash App account. 1-888-343-0953
